title: Kumorebi, a cozy game set in rural Japan
author: SarcasmBlackHole
selftext:
Hello everyone,

As a developer, I’ve always fancied trying my hand at developing a few video games, but I’ve never actually got round to it.

Now, with AI and a few ideas, I wanted to do some experiments, mainly to assess the potential of AI in games and test some techniques that might also be useful at work.

After three days of development, Komorebi emerged – a cozy game set in rural Japan, 50 years in the future, where robots live alongside humans and help them with their work.

You play as a mechanic, responsible for looking after the robots in a very peaceful community.

What do you think of the idea? I’d love some feedback.

If you like the idea and fancy contributing, I’d be delighted to make the GitHub repository public and continue working on it together.

Thank you

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body: It’s cute but I don’t think the robot and background art match all the time. Also, what’s the gameplay? This was just clicking through dialogue.

replies.author: SarcasmBlackHole
replies.body:
You’re right, they don’t match perfectly.

As for the gameplay, it could do with being expanded, making the repair process more complex; you might not notice it from the video, but there are interactions you need to carry out on the robots.

replies.author: BoltVnderhuge
replies.body:
Yeah, if the repairs were more like small puzzles, this could be cool! I’m thinking something like a bunch of mini games like a sudoku, screw puzzle game, Japanese game ripoffs… etc

Or you could do full surgeries like ‘Trauma Center’ on the 3DS. 

The aesthetic and world is nice, but it needs a game!

comments.author: Pitiful-Assistance-1
comments.body: It looks very AI generated. Yes, I know it is, but it also looks that way
